description.value: Opal is one of three modernized A-frame cottages at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness and yoga destination set on 20 acres of forested land on Bowen Island. Reaching the property requires a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. All cottage stays include daily breakfast and yoga and meditation sessions as part of the retreat experience.

address.value: 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC, V0N 1G2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags a single unit called 'Opal' as a tourism=chalet operated by Nectar Yoga Retreat; the website confirms Opal is one of three A-frame cottages in a yoga/wellness retreat on Bowen Island (720 Gardner Lane). The website describes accommodation amenities in detail but makes no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific services; daily breakfast is included but described as part of the experience package, not cyclist-oriented. The website footer provides phone (6049476999) and address not present in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Vancouver' but the property is on Bowen Island, a separate municipality — coordinates are consistent with Bowen Island.
OSM tags contain no phone or address; both were sourced from website footer (phone: 6049476999, address: 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC, V0N 1G2).
OSM record is for a single cottage unit ('Opal') within a larger multi-cottage retreat property — a listing at the property level may be more appropriate than one per cottage.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a functioning, bookable accommodation on Bowen Island, but it is a yoga/wellness retreat with no mention of cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, bike procedures, tools, or charging). A ferry crossing is required to reach it, which limits its utility for touring cyclists on-route; human review should confirm whether it merits directory inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation are included with all cottage stays per the website. The A-frame section of the website was truncated; Wi-Fi and full amenity list for Opal specifically could not be confirmed, though other cottage types on the same property list in-room Wi-Fi.
